title: 第 4 讲：完成时态专攻

reading.title: Friday, 5 p.m.

sentences.en: The release has just gone out, and my phone has already buzzed three times.
sentences.zh: 发布刚发出去，我的手机已经震了三次。

sentences.en: A user says the app has crashed twice since the update.
sentences.zh: 一位用户说自更新以来应用已经崩溃了两次。

sentences.en: By the time I opened my laptop and checked the dashboard, the team had already collected the logs.
sentences.zh: 等我打开笔记本、看过仪表盘时，团队已经收集好日志了。

sentences.en: Someone had pushed a broken flag on Thursday — nobody had noticed it before the release.
sentences.zh: 有人周四就推送了一个坏掉的开关——在发布之前没人注意到它。

sentences.en: We have fixed similar bugs before, so we followed the old playbook: revert first, ask questions later.
sentences.zh: 我们以前修过类似的 bug，所以照老剧本办事：先回滚，再问问题。

sentences.en: Now the crash rate has dropped to zero.
sentences.zh: 现在崩溃率已经降到零。

sentences.en: My butler has not slept since Monday — it keeps sending reports every hour.
sentences.zh: 我的管家从周一起就没睡过——它每小时都在持续发送报告。

sentences.en: Automation has saved us again, and this time nobody had to work late.
sentences.zh: 自动化又救了我们一次，这次没人需要加班。

reading.translation: 周五下午五点。发布刚发出去，我的手机已经震了三次。一位用户说自更新以来应用已经崩溃了两次。等我打开笔记本、看过仪表盘时，团队已经收集好日志了。有人周四就推送了一个坏掉的开关——在发布之前没人注意到它。我们以前修过类似的 bug，所以照老剧本办事：先回滚，再问问题。现在崩溃率已经降到零。我的管家从周一起就没睡过——它每小时都在持续发送报告。自动化又救了我们一次，这次没人需要加班

keyPoints.analysis: just / already / yet 是现在完成的标志 — 过去动作 + 现在的结果（手机在震）

keyPoints.sentence: **By the time** I opened my laptop, the team **had** already **collected** the logs.
keyPoints.analysis: opened 是**过去锚点**；收集日志发生在锚点之前 → 过去的过去 → had done
before 不带具体过去时间 = 「经验」→ 现在完成；对照 followed（过去的做法用一般过去）

core.meaning: v. 崩溃 / n. 崩溃
n. 更新 / v. 更新
n. 功能开关 / 旗标

wordGroups.sentence: the crash rate **has dropped** to zero
wordGroups.collocations: drop to + 数字；drop a feature
follow the steps；as follows 如下

practice.title: 选时态 — 一般过去 / 现在完成 / 过去完成

questions.explanation: in 2023 具体过去时间 → 一般过去（完成时不与具体过去时间连用）

questions.stem: She ___ (fix) three bugs so far this week.
questions.explanation: so far this week → 现在完成

questions.stem: By the time the alert fired, the backup ___ (finish) already.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去锚点（the alert fired）→ 锚点之前 → 过去完成

questions.stem: Our monitor ___ (catch) every error since last month.
questions.explanation: since last month 持续到现在 → 现在完成；catch 不规则：catch → caught → caught
arrived 是过去锚点，离开在锚点之前 → 过去完成
just 是现在完成的标志词（美式口语中也用一般过去 checked；本册取完成时口径）

questions.stem: The service has been down ___ two hours.
We have followed this playbook ___ the last incident.
questions.explanation: the last incident 事件 = 时间点

questions.stem: It has kept running ___ six weeks without a restart.
She has saw this error before.
questions.reference: She has seen this error before.
questions.explanation: see 的过去分词是 seen（see → saw → seen）

questions.stem: When I arrived, they already left.
questions.reference: When I arrived, they had already left.
questions.explanation: arrived 是过去锚点，离开在其之前 → 过去完成

questions.stem: He has finished the task yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 具体过去时间，禁用完成时；改用一般过去

practice.title: 时间轴写作 — 用 3 句写一次小事故 — 句 1 一般过去（锚点）、句 2 过去完成（锚点前）、句 3 现在完成（影响至今）

questions.stem: 用 3 句写一次小事故 — 句 1 一般过去（锚点）、句 2 过去完成（锚点前）、句 3 现在完成（影响至今）。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 句 1 一般过去作锚点（如 At 9 a.m., the alarm fired）；句 2 had done 描述锚点前的动作（如 The intern had pushed the config the night before）；句 3 have done 讲影响至今（如 We have added a review step since then）

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 句 2 的 had done 必须能指出句 1 作为锚点；句 3 不得出现具体过去时间

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 三句时态各就各位，且句 2 的 had done 能明确指出句 1 的锚点、句 3 无具体过去时间，即通过

practice.title: 对比造句 — 用下列两组时间提示各造一句，体会差异

questions.explanation: yesterday 具体过去时间，不能加 have

answers: I have fixed five bugs since Monday.
questions.explanation: 起点到现在的累计，不能写具体星期几的过去点
